decision: The exact final atlas passes the face repair and native visual continuity review. All sixteen look directions retain coherent rounded two-eye faces and readable principal quadrants/cardinals; both running rows retain the same character face through plausible gait poses. No concrete visual blocker was found.

scope.preservation_evidence: qa/preserved-states-final.json reports pixel identity for the 41 preserved frames. This review read that provenance record after visual inspection; it did not independently compare against a separate baseline PNG.

method: Viewed the actual final state contact sheet, direction sheet, native boundary panel, before/after face comparison, and motion stills. Independently cropped the exact hashed encoded cells into native full-body look and gait sheets and enlarged head/mid-body inspection panels. Checked the mid-body alpha warnings against the actual final cells on a dark contrasting background, then compared the investigation panel. Neither other reviewers' votes nor numeric continuity outlier thresholds were used as the acceptance gate. Uniform mathematical angular spacing and full 90-degree profile heads were not required.

requested_face_shape_repair.evidence: The old long flat lower jaw, projecting chin, and one-eye full-profile face are replaced by rounded cheeks, tiny noses, short curved chins, and two visible eyes with appropriate foreshortening. This holds in both movement rows and all turned look faces.

same_character_and_style.evidence: Violet eyes, compact pale face, white/lavender fringe, horns, anatomical-left rosette, costume, wings, and scaled tail remain coherent with the preserved neutral and action poses. No conspicuous alternate face design or rendering style appears in the repaired rows.

up_right_look_quadrant.evidence: Physical cheek/nose turn and eye foreshortening establish a right bias while the face and eyes remain upward. Similar adjacent poses retain the correct quadrant.

down_right_look_quadrant.evidence: The final 135 and 157.5 faces now retain visible rightward cheek/nose turn and a reduced far-eye presentation under downward pitch. They no longer read only as centered down. The compact two-eye face remains intact.

down_left_look_quadrant.evidence: The face and gaze retain a leftward physical bias while coming out of the bowed pose. The nose/cheek and near/far-eye arrangement distinguish these from down-right without restoring a full profile.

up_left_look_quadrant.evidence: Modest leftward head/gaze bias remains visible with upward presentation, reducing toward the near-frontal upward end. No conspicuous strong-side-view-to-front snap remains.

four_cardinals.evidence: 000 reads up, 090 reads screen-right with a compact three-quarter head, 180 reads centered down, and 270 reads screen-left with a modest opposite cheek/nose turn. Both sideward cardinal faces retain both eyes and short chins.

adjacent_look_and_loop_continuity.evidence: All adjacent looks retain coherent character structure and direction. The 157.5-to-180 change reads as a shallow right-down pose becoming a centered bow; the 337.5-to-000 change reads as a small shift into a stronger centered upward tilt. Neither produces a conspicuous head/body size pop or identity snap at native size.

head_body_scale_and_registration.evidence: New look rows and preserved standing poses keep consistent practical height, head-to-body balance, body centering, and foot baseline. Small wing-spread and face-silhouette changes read as pose rather than a whole-character rescale.

running_faces_and_gaits.evidence: All sixteen actual encoded running cells keep the same rounded, short-chin, two-eye face. Forward lean with trailing hair/robe/tail makes each travel direction clear. Alternating bent, lifted, lowered, and forward-reaching legs read as a plausible running gait, with no conspicuous malformed limb, face jump, or head-scale change.

wings_tail_robe_and_rosette.evidence: Wings stay attached at the back/shoulder region, tail and robe retain coherent shape and scale, and the rosette remains physically attached on anatomical left. Directional occlusion is plausible.

clipping_and_material_interior_seams.evidence: No conspicuous clipped horn, hair, wing, tail, robe hem, hand, or foot was found. No transparent seam or material hole cuts through the torso, hands, thigh, or main robe body.

preserved_actions_and_landing.evidence: The preserved idle, wave, expressions, and five-frame jump remain readable and coherent with the repaired faces. The jump sequence retains crouch, rise, apex, fall, and grounded crouch with a natural return to standing.

alpha_warning_investigation.evidence: The exact final cells on a dark background show background-visible spaces beneath the wings and beside the separate robe/leg and tail contours. These are exterior gaps between illustrated components, not holes or seams through the body. The enlarged actual mid-body crops keep the bodice, hands, thigh, and central robe continuous. The investigation panel is consistent with that direct encoded-cell inspection.
